name: Special Delivery for Gaxim
summary: Gaxim Rustfizzle waits in Stonetalon for an enchanted scroll from Stormwind. Its magic may let him set off an explosive from afar and hinder the Venture Company's deforestation.

sections.title: Arcane Deliveries
sections.body: Gaxim Rustfizzle is trying to hinder the Venture Company's destructive work in the Stonetalon Mountains. He has made an explosive compound called NG-5, but has no sure way to set it off from afar. So he sought help across the Great Sea. In Stormwind's Mage Quarter, Collin Mauren has made an enchanted Scroll of Messaging for him.

sections.title: A Remote Distraction
sections.body: Gaxim Rustfizzle plans to bind the Scroll of Messaging's magic to his unstable NG-5 mixture. The scroll can carry messages across long distances, and that power can trigger the explosive from afar. Gaxim wants the blast to make a devastating distraction. Then operatives may slip into the Venture Company compound unseen.

faq.q: What is the Scroll of Messaging used for?
faq.answer: The Scroll of Messaging carries words across long distances. Gaxim Rustfizzle can bind its magic to NG-5 and use it as a remote trigger, setting off explosives from a safe distance.
Collin Mauren is an Alliance wizard in Stormwind City's Mage Quarter. He handles arcane matters and crafts the enchanted scroll Gaxim needs in Stonetalon.

faq.q: Why is Gaxim Rustfizzle sabotaging the Venture Company?
faq.answer: The Venture Company is ruthlessly clear-cutting the Stonetalon Mountains' pristine forests. Gaxim aims to slow the deforestation by causing chaos, destroying their operations, and stealing their engineering plans and correspondence.

faq.q: Where does this delivery take the adventurer?
faq.answer: You travel from Stormwind City across the sea to the Alliance camp in the crags of the Stonetalon Mountains on Kalimdor.

faq.q: What happens after the scroll is delivered?
faq.answer: With the scroll and NG-5 in hand, Gaxim prepares a remote explosive distraction. It clears a path for an operative to enter the Windshear Crag operations and recover logging letters and schematics.

angles.text: Gaxim's scheme joins gnomish engineering with wizardry. Volatile NG-5 explosives meet arcane triggers.
Collin Mauren shows how clever tinkerers can turn a simple parchment enchantment into a working arcane relay.
As an Alliance member, you see the ties between Stormwind and remote outposts resisting industrial exploitation in Kalimdor.
